senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חָשָׁה)to think, intend, plan.
units: Ber. 6ᵃ; Kidd. 40ᵃ (ref. to Mal. III, 16) אפי׳ ח׳ אדם וכ׳ even if one only had the intention of doing etc.; Sabb. 63ᵃ חִישֵּׁב (Pi.).—Tanḥ. P’kudé 11 וכשהן חוֹשְׁבִין להעמידו וכ׳ and when they thought they had put it up, it fell apart again.
<cite ref="Sotah 35a:8">Sot. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>אני חֲשַׁבְתִּיהָ</he> … <he>והם חָשְׁבוּ וכ׳</he> I planned it for their good, but they considered it an evil; a. fr.

<cite ref="Berakhot 14a:12">Ber. 14ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 2:22">Is. II, 22</cite>) <he>במה חֲשַׁבְתּוֹ לזה ולא לאלוה</he> with what right didst thou pay thy regard to him and not to God?—Sot. l. c., v. supra.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite>, v. <cite ref="O00394"><he>סוֹפִיסְטָא</he></cite>; a. fr.
Yoma 72ᵇ (ref. to חשב a. רקם, Ex. XXVI, 31ᵃ 36) רוקמין במקום שחוֹשְׁבִין they embroidered over what they had traced.—Part. pass. חָשׁוּב fem. חֲשׁוּבָה
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 5</cite> <he>לא … מדינה ח׳ כלום</he> the country towns were of no account.

<cite ref="Nedarim 64b:6">Ned. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ כמת</he> is like dead; <cite ref="Nedarim 64b:6">ib.</cite> <he>חֲשׁוּבִין כמת</he>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 71:6">Gen. R. s. 71</cite> <he>חֲשׁוּבִים כמתים</he>; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Beitzah 3b:11">Bets. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>ביצה ח׳</he> an egg is a valuable object.
<cite ref="Berakhot 19a">Ber. 19ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אדם ח׳ שאני</he> with a man of high standing it is different.
<cite ref="Pesachim 108a:10">Pes. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>אשה ח׳</he> a woman of rank. Tanḥ. Shmini 9 <he>איש ח׳ שמחשבים וכ׳</he> a man of standing whom they respected in his place; a. fr.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to consider, regard; to respect, v. supra.

units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 78b:13">B. Bath. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>המְחַשְּׁבִים</he> the thoughtful.
<cite ref="Shabbat 150a:11">Sabb. 150ᵃ</cite>. <he>חשבונות … לחַשְּׁבָן וכ׳</he> accounts of a religious nature may be figured out on the Sabbath.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:1">Ab. II, 1</cite> <he>הוי מְחַשְּׁב וכ׳</he> count what you sacrifice in doing good, against what you gain thereby.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 65b:19">Snh. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>המח׳ עתים וכ׳</he> he who calculates seasons and hours (which are auspicious and which are not).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97b:9">Ib. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>מְחַשְּׁבֵי קיצין</he> those who make calculations (from Biblical verses) as to when the Messiah will come; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Shabbat 150b:1">Sabb. 150ᵇ</cite> top <he>מותר לחוֹשְׁבָן</he> (Kal), Ms. M. <he>לחַשְּׁ׳</he>.]—V. <cite ref="H01809"><he>חֶשְׁבּוֹן</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (sub. מחשבה זרה) to have in mind an undue intention in the performance of a sacrificial ceremony.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 48a:9">Yoma 48ᵃ</cite> <he>חי׳ בחפינת וכ׳</he> if he had an undue intention when grasping the frankincense (e.g. to offer it tomorrow).
<cite ref="Yoma 48b:1">Ib.ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be counted. Ohol. I, 3 אין האהל מִתְחַשֵּׁב the tent is not counted (as a special item).
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 768:3">Yalk. Num. 768</cite> <he>מתח׳ לנו</he> will be counted against us (be deducted from our share).
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 3:3">Mikv. III, 3</cite> <he>עד שיִתְחַשֵּׁב וכ׳</he> until it is calculated that all the original water has run off.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 44:1">Pesik. R. s. 44</cite> the former sins <he>אינן מִתְחַשְּׁבוֹת לו וכ׳</he> are not counted or remembered to him.

senses.gloss: to be considered, believed to be. Tanḥ. Masé 5, v. כַּזְבָּן.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 8:11">Shebi. VIII, 11</cite> <he>אם מתחשב הוא</he> (Ms. M. <he>כמ׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if he (is like one who) holds a high position.

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 2:7">Tosef. Ab. Zar. II, 7</cite> <he>ואם מתחשב וכ׳</he> but when he (the Israelite besieging a city) does it as an ally (in the Roman interest), he is forbidden (to conduct the siege); <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18b:6">Ab. Zar. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>ובלבד שלא יִתְחַשֵּׁב עמהם</he> provided he does not conspire with them; <he>ואם נתח׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>יתח׳</he>); Y. ib. I, 40ᵃ <he>מתחשד</he> (corr. acc.).
